companies.bayNote: San Francisco Bay Area = the metros covering the nine Bay Area counties: San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont, San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara, Santa Rosa-Petaluma, Napa, Vallejo.

list.name: AT&T
list.notes: AT&T's US postings give one range and no zones. For its field and retail sales roles the range includes salary and commission. Its union job families (CWA, IBEW) are left out of pay search.
list.basis_quote: Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training

list.name: Abbott
list.notes: Abbott's US postings give one base pay range and no zones; it says the range may differ in some locations without naming them. Many postings give none.
list.basis_quote: In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted

list.name: Activision Blizzard
list.notes: Activision, Blizzard and King (part of Microsoft) post one range “across all U.S. locations” and no zones. Hourly roles are left out of the pay ranges here.
list.basis_quote: your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location

list.name: Adobe
list.notes: Adobe's US postings give one US range and say it pays differently by “defined markets” it doesn't name. Most also add a range for the job's own state (California, New York, Washington, Illinois, Massachusetts or Colorado); those aren't shown here yet.
list.basis_quote: Pay within this range varies by work location

list.name: Affirm
list.notes: Affirm's postings give one base pay range for California, Washington, New York, New Jersey and Connecticut and another for all other US states. They don't call them zones; we use their wording as the names. Read on 83 of its current postings.
list.basis_quote: based on a variety of factors, including location

list.name: Agilent
list.notes: Agilent's US postings give one full-time equivalent pay range and no zones; a recruiter can share the range for a preferred location.
list.basis_quote: Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training

list.name: Airbnb
list.notes: Airbnb's US postings give one pay range and no zones. Its postings list training, skills, experience, business needs and market demands as what sets pay, not location.

list.name: Airtable
zones: SF Bay Area, Seattle, LA, New York
list.notes: Airtable's postings give two ranges and name the places for the higher one. We matched each to its metro.
list.basis_quote: For work locations in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York

list.name: Alignment Healthcare
list.notes: Alignment Health's postings give one pay range and no zones; many roles are hourly.
list.basis_quote: Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc

list.name: Alliant Energy
list.notes: Alliant Energy's postings give one pay range and no zones; sales roles give base pay plus commission.

list.name: Ally Financial
list.notes: Ally's postings give one base pay range and no zones.

list.name: Alnylam
list.notes: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals' postings give one U.S. pay range and no zones.

list.name: Amazon
list.notes: Amazon posts a range for each city a role is open in and publishes no zone list. We group its cities by metro: each place here lists the cities Amazon's current postings name in that metro, and a posting's range for each of those cities shows for it. Cities outside any metro and “Virtual Location” ranges are left out. AWS, Ring, Zappos and Audible hire through amazon.jobs.
list.basis_quote: Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location

list.name: Ameren

list.name: American Express

list.name: Ameriprise
list.notes: Ameriprise Financial's postings give one estimated base salary range and no zones; many give none.
list.basis_quote: Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location

list.name: Amgen
list.notes: Amgen's postings give an expected annual salary range for the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico), sometimes one per level, and no zones; many say only that the range is posted elsewhere.

list.name: Analog Devices
list.notes: Analog Devices' US postings give one expected wage range for a new hire and no zones.
list.basis_quote: Actual wage offered may vary depending on work location

list.name: Anthropic
list.notes: Anthropic's US postings give one annual range covering every office the role lists, and no zones. For sales roles the range is on-target earnings.

list.name: Apollo.io
list.notes: Apollo.io's postings give a Tier 1 range for San Francisco, New York City and Seattle and a Tier 2 range for all other US locations, the same in 19 of its 45 postings on 24 Nov. We match each city to its metro; Apollo.io names San Francisco, not the whole Bay Area, so San Jose and the rest of the Bay Area show Tier 2.

list.name: AppLovin
list.notes: AppLovin's US postings give one base pay range for California, New York and Washington and one for all other states. Some older postings give a range for California or New York alone; those are left out.
list.basis_quote: Total compensation at AppLovin is based on a number of factors including market location

list.name: Apple
list.notes: Apple posts a range for each office a role is open in, and publishes no zone list. We group its offices by metro: each place here lists the offices Apple's current postings name in that metro. Offices in states without a pay-range law (Texas, among others) show no range. Postings that name only the “San Francisco Bay Area” are left out, since that spans two metros. Hourly ranges are left out.
list.basis_quote: your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location

list.name: Asana
list.notes: Long Island and Newark are inside the New York-Newark-Jersey City metro.
list.basis_quote: based on your specific home location

list.name: Atlassian
list.notes: Atlassian defines zones by county, and doesn't publish the county list. We count the Tri-State Area as the New York metro plus Bridgeport-Stamford, CT.
list.basis_quote: based on your specific home location / county

list.name: Axon
list.notes: Axon's US postings give a base pay range and no zones. A posting open in several cities can list a higher range alongside it without saying which city it is for; each distinct range is shown.
list.basis_quote: The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors

list.name: BILL
list.notes: BILL (Bill.com) lists three geographic zones in its job postings, the same in all 37 on 24 Nov. We match by metro: BILL's Zone 1 names Los Angeles County, so Orange County (in the Los Angeles metro) shows Zone 1 here, and "New York City" is matched as the New York metro. The rest of Texas isn't listed.
list.basis_quote: based on a variety of factors including candidate experience, expertise, and geographic location

list.name: Baxter
list.notes: Baxter's US postings give one estimated base salary range and no zones; hourly roles give a single rate.
list.basis_quote: Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors

list.name: Benchling
list.notes: Anywhere within 100 miles of a listed city takes that city's zone; we match by metro only, so check if you're near one. We put all of New York state outside the NYC metro in Zone 2, but Benchling says places within 100 miles of the city are Zone 1.
list.basis_quote: If your work location is within a 100 mile radius of a hiring location

list.name: Block
list.notes: Block lists cities, not metros; we matched each to its metro. Places about 50 miles outside a listed metro may be in a different zone. Scottsdale is in the Phoenix metro.
list.basis_quote: work locations that are approximately 50 miles outside of the metro area

list.name: Boeing
list.notes: Boeing's US postings give a summary pay range, often one per level (Associate, Mid-Level, Senior/Lead), and no zones. They don't say whether it is base pay.

list.name: Burlington
list.notes: Burlington's postings give one compensation range and no zones; most are store roles.
list.basis_quote: Individual pay decisions will be based on a variety of factors, such as but not limited to, qualifications, education, job-related skills, relevant experience, and geographic location

list.name: C.H. Robinson
list.notes: C.H. Robinson's postings give one base pay range; most cover the position across all US locations, and those are shown. Some give a range for one specific location instead; those are left out.
list.basis_quote: Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor

list.name: CVS Health
list.notes: CVS Health's US postings give one typical range for the role's job grade and no zones. Most of its postings are store and pharmacy jobs paid hourly; pay search shows its office roles.
list.basis_quote: The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors

list.name: Calendly
list.notes: Calendly lists its tiers in job postings; we matched each city to its metro. Its postings also say it's registered as an employer in many, but not all, states.
list.basis_quote: the zip code of an employee's remote work location, or the onsite building location if hybrid

list.name: Calix
list.notes: Calix doesn't name its zones; the names here are its group headings. Raleigh-Durham covers the Raleigh-Cary and Durham-Chapel Hill metros.

list.name: Carrier
list.notes: Carrier's postings give one annual salary range and no zones; many give none.

list.name: Cboe

list.basis_quote: with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location

list.name: Chipotle

list.name: Cigna
list.notes: The Cigna Group's US postings give one annual salary range and no zones; some postings give none.
list.basis_quote: depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location

list.name: Coca-Cola

list.basis_quote: Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience

list.name: CoreWeave

list.name: Coursera

list.name: CrowdStrike

list.name: Databricks

list.name: Datadog
list.notes: Datadog's US postings give one reasonably estimated yearly salary range and no zones.

Left out: remote roles (one range that, Disney says, factors in geographic regions), ranges given for a whole state or for two cities at once, and cities outside any metro.

list.name: Eversource

list.basis_quote: In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience

list.name: Scotts Miracle-Gro
list.notes: Scotts Miracle-Gro's postings give one starting budgeted pay range and no zones; many give none.
list.basis_quote: Scotts will consider various factors in determining the actual pay including your skills, qualifications, experience, and geographical location

list.name: ServiceTitan
list.notes: ServiceTitan lists two zones by state in its job postings, the same in all 48 US postings that show a range on 24 Nov. A metro that crosses state lines follows the first state in its name, so Philadelphia shows Zone 2 here though its New Jersey side is Zone 1, and Portland shows Zone 2 though Vancouver, WA is Zone 1.
list.basis_quote: For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is

list.name: Snap
list.notes: Snap puts all of California and Washington in Zone A, but only New York City (not the rest of New York).
list.basis_quote: work locations are assigned a pay zone

list.name: Snowflake
list.notes: Snowflake's US postings give one salary range and no zones.

list.name: Spotify
list.notes: Spotify's US postings give one “United States base range” and no zones; most US roles are in New York.

list.name: Sprout Social
list.notes: Sprout Social's postings say it has two geographic pay zones in the United States and name the states in each.

list.name: State Street
list.notes: State Street gives one salary range per posting, for the role's primary location. We group those locations by metro: each place here lists the cities State Street's current postings name in that metro, and a posting's range shows for its primary location.
list.basis_quote: If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ

list.name: Stewart
list.notes: Stewart Information Services' postings give one base salary range and no zones; many give none.
list.basis_quote: actual offers will be based on the individual candidate’s knowledge, skills, education, experience, location, market conditions

list.name: Stripe
list.notes: Stripe's US postings give one annual US range and no zones. For sales roles the range is on-target earnings.
list.basis_quote: will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location

list.name: T. Rowe Price
zones: Maryland, Colorado, Washington and remote workers
list.notes: T. Rowe Price's postings give a base salary range for three groups of locations. Many roles give the same range for all three.
list.basis_quote: Please review the job posting for the location of this specific opportunity

list.name: TIAA
list.notes: TIAA's US postings give one base pay range and no zones.
list.basis_quote: Actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, base salary of internal peers, prior performance, business sector, and geographic location

list.name: Target
list.notes: Target's postings give one pay range and no zones; they don't say whether it is base pay. Most are store and distribution jobs paid hourly; pay search shows its office roles.
list.basis_quote: These include labor markets and in some instances may include education, work experience and certifications

list.name: Temporal
list.notes: Temporal counts a metro as 50 miles from the city centre. The percent is of Tier 1 pay. Sales commission roles (except BDRs) are Tier 1 anywhere. West Palm Beach is in the Miami metro.
list.basis_quote: If your location lies just beyond one of these metro areas

list.name: Toast
list.notes: Toast gives example cities for each zone, not a full list, so only those cities are matched here.
list.basis_quote: determined by office location or, for remote roles, home address (zip code)

list.name: Travelers
list.notes: Travelers' US postings give one annual base range, which it calls a nationwide market range, and no zones.
list.basis_quote: The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role

list.name: Trimble
list.notes: Trimble's US postings give one hiring range and no zones, and say whether the role is bonus or commission eligible.

list.name: Tutor Perini
list.notes: Tutor Perini's postings give one expected salary range and no zones; many give none.

list.name: Twilio
list.notes: The tiers appear on a few of Twilio's postings (4 of 114 on 24 Nov), worded the same each time. Tier 2 lists "Maryland" and Tier 3 lists "Maryland (outside of the DC area)"; we read it as the D.C. area in Tier 2 and the rest of Maryland in Tier 3. Areas are matched by metro: the Bay Area as its five metros, the NYC area as the New York metro, the D.C. area as the Washington metro (including its Virginia counties). New Jersey counties in the Philadelphia metro count as Pennsylvania here, which Twilio doesn't list.
list.basis_quote: provided for candidates hired in those locations only

list.name: Twitch
list.notes: Twitch (part of Amazon) posts a range for each city a role is open in, from Seattle, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Irvine; which cities appear changes from posting to posting, and it publishes no zone list. We match each city to its metro (Irvine is in the Los Angeles metro).
list.basis_quote: Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location

list.name: USAA
list.notes: USAA's US postings give one salary range and no zones.
list.basis_quote: The actual salary for this role may vary by location

list.name: UnitedHealth Group
list.notes: UnitedHealth Group's US postings give one salary range and no zones. Its clinical postings give an annual total cash target that includes hourly and incentive pay; those are left out of pay search.
list.basis_quote: Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets

list.name: Unum
list.notes: Unum's postings give one base salary range and no zones.
list.basis_quote: Unless actual salary is indicated above in the job description, actual pay will be based on skill, geographical location and experience

list.name: Veeam
list.notes: Veeam lists four zones in its job postings, the same in all 21 that show them on 24 Nov. Its Zone 1 is the five New York City boroughs only; we match by metro, so Long Island, Westchester and the New Jersey side of the New York metro show Zone 1 here, where Veeam puts the rest of New York in Zone 3 and New Jersey in Zone 4. Veeam also puts sales roles in Georgia, Ohio and Arizona in Zone 3; other roles there are Zone 4, which is what this shows.

list.name: Verily
list.notes: Verily's US postings give one range “across all US locations” and no zones.
list.basis_quote: Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors

list.name: Viatris
list.notes: Viatris' US postings give one salary range and no zones; many give none.
list.basis_quote: Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location

list.name: Visa
list.notes: Visa's US postings give one estimated salary range and no zones; for sales roles it may include sales incentive payments.
list.basis_quote: Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location

list.name: Waymo
list.notes: Waymo's US postings give one range “across US locations” and no zones. Hourly intern rates are left out here.
list.basis_quote: Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level

list.name: Wing
list.notes: Wing (part of Alphabet) posts one US base range and no zones.
list.basis_quote: Wing’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location

list.name: Wintrust
list.notes: Wintrust's postings give one estimated salary range and no zones; many give none.

list.name: Workday
list.notes: Workday gives a base pay range for each posting's primary location and a second one for any additional US locations. We group the primary locations by metro: each place here lists the cities Workday's current postings name in that metro, and a posting's primary-location range shows for it. The additional-locations ranges aren't shown.
list.basis_quote: Workday pay ranges vary based on work location

list.name: Writer
list.notes: Writer's postings name two tiers; some postings show only one of them. We count SF as the San Francisco-Oakland metro.

list.name: Xcel Energy
list.notes: Xcel Energy's postings for non-union roles give one anticipated starting base pay range and no zones.

list.name: Zillow
list.notes: Zillow's postings give two state groups without naming them; we number them from highest pay. Office roles must live within commuting distance of their office.

list.name: Zoox
list.notes: Zoox (part of Amazon) posts one base range per role and no zones; most roles are in Foster City, CA.
list.basis_quote: Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level
